tasks.label: Docker Compose: airflow up
tasks.command: docker compose up airflow-init airflow-webserver airflow-scheduler

tasks.label: Dev Container: pytest
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.devcontainer.yaml run --rm --no-deps workspace-dev python -m pytest -q

tasks.label: Dev Container: ruff
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.devcontainer.yaml run --rm --no-deps workspace-dev ruff check .
